bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
old=create-videobot:before-album-id-5aff60b6
new=create-videobot:album-id-5aff60b6-tested
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}' 2>/dev/null)" = true || exit 61
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll -q | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 62
live="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')"
old_id="$(docker image inspect "$old" --format '{{.Id}}')"
new_id="$(docker image inspect "$new" --format '{{.Id}}')"
tag_id="$(docker image inspect create-videobot:local-poll --format '{{.Id}}')"
test "$live" = "$old_id" || { test "$live" = "$new_id" && exit 81;exit 82; }
test "$tag_id" = "$old_id" || exit 83
docker logs "$cid" 2>&1 | grep -Fq 'CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS' || exit 84
docker logs "$cid" 2>&1 | grep -Fq 'STICKER_SHOP_HTTP_READY=PASS' || exit 85
echo VIDEO_PRODUCTION_ROLLBACK_RUNNING_PREVIOUS_IMAGE=PASS
